pose: A comical defeat scene. In the foreground, the larger feathered dinosaur stands entirely still on the dirt path, its body slumped and arms dropping to its sides. It looks directly at the camera with a profoundly confused, wide-eyed, scratching-its-head facial expression as its elaborate hunting plan falls apart. Way out in the background, near the tree line of the sunlit meadow, a few small juvenile sauropods are small silhouettes sprinting away, kicking up tiny puffs of dust as they successfully escape out of reach.
